meta.name: The Immaculate Room
meta.description: Mike and Kate, a young couple, get the once-in-a lifetime chance to win a cool five million dollars. The challenge: Live for 50 days in a blank space. Sticking it out for thirty days, and the five million are theirs. How difficult can it be?
meta.slogan: 1 room. 2 people. $5 million. If you leave, you lose.
